description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithTime', which implements a value formatter interface to format DateTime objects into a 'H:i:s' time string.

classes.name: FormatWithTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into time strings in 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the time component of a DateTime object as a string in 'H:i:s' format, or null if the input is not a DateTime instance.
